instructions: Put 10 cups of water, the anchovies and the kelp in a large pot. Bring to a boil over high heat, then take out the kelp. Simmer the anchovies on medium for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, fill a second large pot with water and set it on to boil for the noodles.
Cut the zucchini into thin matchsticks and transfer them into a bowl. Toss with 1/2 tsp of the salt and leave for 5 to 10 minutes. Cut the carrots into thin matchsticks and slice the mushrooms thin.
Strain the broth into a clean pot and throw the anchovies away. Stir in the soy sauce, 1 tsp salt and 1/8 tsp pepper. Keep it on low heat.
Squeeze the zucchini dry. Heat 1 tsp of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add the zucchini and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until just soft. Transfer to a plate.
Add 1 tsp oil to the skillet, then the carrots, mushrooms, the last 1/4 tsp salt and 1/8 tsp pepper. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring. Transfer to the plate next to the zucchini.

Beat the eggs in a bowl. Wipe the skillet, add the last 1 tsp oil, and turn the heat to medium-low. Pour in the eggs and tilt the pan so they spread thin. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until the top is set. Slide the egg onto a cutting board, roll it up, and slice it into thin strips.
Cook the somyeon in the boiling water for 3 minutes. Drain, rinse well under cold water, and drain again.
Divide the noodles among 4 bowls. Ladle some hot broth over the noodles, pour it back into the pot, and repeat once so the noodles are warm. Then fill each bowl with broth.
Top each bowl with the zucchini, carrot, mushrooms and egg, and serve right away.
method_notes: Korean Bapsang leads (4.80 from 29): a light soup soy broth over somyeon, with sautéed zucchini, carrot and mushroom and thin egg strips. Amounts are doubled from its 2 servings. The broth is made from dried anchovies and kelp as Korean Bapsang and Beyond Kimchee both suggest. Beyond Kimchee (5 from 1) tops with seasoned bean sprouts and chives and a gochugaru sauce, which are left out so the soup stays mild. The beef and kimchi toppings are left out too. Total is about 35 minutes.
